bio.name: Ranielli Montagna
bio.intro: a software engineer with 5+ years building web and mobile products that need to scale. I worked with React, React Native, TypeScript, Node.js and Next.js on products that demanded performance and a great experience. Today I work beyond the code: engineering, product and business in the same conversation.
bio.journey: At Lemon Energia, a distributed-generation energytech, I sit at the bridge between business and technology: I run discovery, translate complex rules into full stack solutions and weigh product trade-offs. In parallel I am co-founder of Atto, a software house and marketing studio that builds custom products for companies — from e-commerce to AI automation. Before that, at Luizalabs (Magalu), I developed solutions for 1,000+ store operations and the daily workflow of 1,000+ stock clerks, led frontend initiatives, created a Design System adopted across multiple products and mentored developers.
bio.hobbies: One of the areas that drives me most is AI applied to development and operations: LLMs, automation, agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). I use it as a lever for productivity and product evolution, always with critical review.

Contributed to the daily workflow of 1,000+ stock clerks in corporate applications
Maintained REST APIs, integrations, and micro frontends with React, React Native, Node.js, and TypeScript
Collaborated with Product, UX, Backend, and Operations to connect technical decisions to business impact

Mentored developers and improved performance, maintainability, and scalability

content.title: How I build web projects
content.paragraph1: On this page, you can explore real projects I built with a focus on user experience, performance, and code quality. Each project starts from a concrete problem and is structured to remain scalable and maintainable.
content.paragraph2: Beyond implementation, I also prioritize architecture, observability, and documentation. The goal is to deliver digital products that run well in production and can evolve safely over time.
points: Modular architecture with reusable components and strong typing.
Performance and Core Web Vitals integrated into the development workflow.
Testing, linting, and CI standards to keep quality consistent.
